Vehicles can be upgraded with veteran crews granting the following effects: 
• +25% Experience Gain

Plus an additional:
• +1300 experience for light vehicles. 
• +1800 experience for medium vehicles 
• +3500 experience for heavy vehicles.

tiger_ak.name: Tiger Heavy Tank
tiger_ak.brief: Extremely effective against all ground targets. \n• Strong front and side armor. \n• High health.

veterancy.text: +30% rotation rate \n+20% rate of fire \n+100% main gun accuracy

upgrades.name: MG 34 Machine Gun
upgrades.brief: Upgrades the unit with a pintle-mounted machine gun.

upgrades.name: Tiger Ace Heavy Tank
upgrades.brief:
Upgrades the Tiger Heavy Tank call-in to deploy a Tiger Ace instead. Tigers that have already been deployed can be upgraded to a Tiger Ace via upgrade.

The Tiger Ace has the following additional attributes: 
• Starts at Veterancy Level 1. 
• Can toggle between Hunter and Marauder modes for different combat bonuses. 
• Can reach Veterancy Level 4.
